svg.title: 03 · Query path
svg.desc: The run worker sends SQL over Quack to the DuckDB query service, which alone holds customer B's 15-minute STS credentials, reads only customer B's gold and writes one audit record per SQL; Customer A is denied by the API and by IAM.
svg.text: Only the DuckDB query service touches the data, with 15-minute credentials for one customer.
the agent never holds AWS credentials
curated tables answer nearly every question
